job.job_description:
This opening is only for candidates from Delhi NCR.




As an AI Engineer, you will design, build, and deploy intelligent systems powered by Generative AI and Agentic AI frameworks. You will work on production-grade AI applications that serve millions of customers and help shape the next generation of digital experiences.




Key Skills

Python
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
LangChain
LangGraph
Agentic AI Frameworks
Prompt Engineering
API Development
Cloud Technologies

What You'll Do

Build production-ready AI applications
Develop multi-agent workflows and orchestration systems
Implement RAG pipelines and knowledge systems
Integrate LLMs into customer-facing products
Optimize AI performance, reliability, and scalability
Collaborate with product, platform, and engineering teams








(*Note: Scout is an independent candidate sourcing partner for this hiring. All applications, candidate screening, and hiring-related actions are conducted directly by the respective employers authorized recruitment team. Relevant candidates will be contacted via email and asked to attempt an assessment.)




Roles and openings are subject to change. The client reserves the right to modify, reassign, or withdraw any role, requirements, number of positions, or timelines at any time during the hiring process. Submission of an application does not guarantee assignment to a particular role or an offer of employment. All hires are contingent on standard pre-employment screening and eligibility verification.




Candidates from Delhi NCR are required
